subject: On-prem exit protections, pilot discount request, and support coverage clarifications
messages:
From: Simon Ward <simon.ward@clearbridgehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@clearbridgehealth.com, Jane Silva <jane.silva@clearbridgehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T14:23:00-07:00
Subject: Questions on on-prem exit guard + pilot discount

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the KV cache behavior for multi-tenant requests. We're kicking off a short procurement review and I want to make sure we understand the commercial levers for a private deployment (VPC/on-prem). A few specific asks from procurement and infra: 

1) Pilot economics: we're proposing a 3-month pilot (non-exclusive) to validate throughput and integrations. What level of platform-fee discount or starter credit can Redwood offer for a short pilot? Would that be amortized onto future commitment if we convert?

2) Exit protections: if we commit for 12 months and later decide to move off-prem, do you offer migration credits or an exit protection window (e.g., credits against unused platform fee / operator-license refund)? We need wording that we can show to legal.

3) Support tiers: can you confirm if L2 on-call during a pilot can be included (weekday business hours), and how much additional cost for 24/7 on-call would be?

4) Attachments: included our RFP (PDF) with the milestones we track for SOC2 evidence and uptime acceptance.

Can you put together two compact options we can review: (A) Pilot-first: 3 months pilot + conversion terms; (B) Commit-1yr: standard committed pricing + migration/exit schedule. High level bullets are fine — procurement needs a one-pager to present to finance tomorrow.

Appreciate it,

Simon
Procurement Manager | ClearBridge Health
Mobile: +1 415-555-0199

Attachment: RFP-CBH-2026.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2MB)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Simon Ward <simon.ward@clearbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Jane Silva <jane.silva@clearbridgehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Questions on on-prem exit guard + pilot discount

Hi Simon — great questions, thanks for the clear list. Below are two compact commercial constructs and the key contractual language bullets you can pass to legal/procurement. Happy to hop on a quick call today if that helps.

Option A — Pilot Starter (3 months)
- Platform fee: waived for first month, then 50% credit for months 2–3 (applied as a monthly credit against bill).
- Conversion: if ClearBridge converts to a 12-month committed agreement within 90 days after pilot end, remaining pilot credits are treated as a prepayment and amortized over the first 6 months of the committed term.
- Support: L2 on-call (business hours PST M–F) included for pilot; escalation to L3 handled via standard incident playbook (response SLA: 4 hours).
- Exit language: pilot has no exit liability. Conversion agreement includes a 60-day remediation window before termination for cause.

Option B — 12-month Commit (preferred price)
- Platform fee: annualized; commit discount 18% off list platform fee when prepaid or 12% when invoiced monthly.
- Migration / Exit credits: if ClearBridge provides 90 days notice and Redwood cannot meet agreed remediation milestones, Redwood will provide a migration credit equal to up to 20% of remaining prepaid platform fees to offset migration costs. (We can tighten language with legal.)
- Support: Business-hours L2 included. 24/7 on-call available as an add-on at a fixed monthly SKU (we'll include cost tiers).

Other notes / recommended contract clauses (short bullets for legal):
- Define "migration credit" trigger events (failure to meet remediation milestones; capacity shortfall >X% for >Y days).
- Cap total migration credits at a percentage of remaining prepaid fees.
- Specify post-conversion amortization schedule for pilot credits (6 months default; optional 12 months by negotiation).

Attachments: I attached a short SOW sketch and our SOC2 evidence summary to speed review. I'll loop in our pricing lead for a detailed grid if you'd like hard numbers.

Next steps: if these look on track, I can have a short pricing grid and draft contract language to you by EOD tomorrow. Do you want the pilot to include a fixed max GPU capacity (so we can guarantee burst), or do you prefer an elastic pilot?

Best,

Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0123

Attachments: SOW-draft-v0.2.pdf (application/pdf, 240KB); SOC2-evidence-summary.zip (application/zip, 900KB)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Questions on on-prem exit guard + pilot discount — need pricing grid + legal language

Marissa / David — forwarding the exchange with ClearBridge (below).

Quick asks:
- Marissa: can you produce a short pricing grid (two rows: Pilot Starter, 12mo Commit) with list platform fee, example monthly invoice amounts (pilot credits applied), and 24/7 on-call SKU? Keep it high level, procurement just needs a one-pager. Target: EOD tomorrow.
- David: legal will need suggested contract language for "migration credit" triggers and cap mechanics. Also want an alternate wording that avoids an open-ended refund (i.e., cap at 20% of remaining prepaid).

Notes: their procurement wants explicit exit protection language they can show in RFP. Also confirm pilot capacity model — I recommended we offer a capped pilot (guaranteed pool) to keep cost predictability. If we switch to elastic pilot we need an explicit burst cap.

I called out the items in my reply; feel free to edit the bullets before I send final pricing.

—Rachel

Subject: Re: Questions on on-prem exit guard + pilot discount

Rachel — thanks for the clear options. We've discussed internally and would like to proceed with a Pilot Starter (capped capacity) under these conditions: 

- Pilot term: 3 months, capped at 8 dedicated GPUs equivalent (as a guaranteed pool) with burst to 12 subject to capacity availability.
- Commercial: platform fee waived for month 1, then 25% credit months 2–3 (we'll trade conversion flexibility for limit on total credit).
- Conversion window: if we convert to a 12-month committed agreement within 120 days of pilot end, we accept the amortization over 6 months.
- Exit protection: we request the migration credit language be stated in the SOW as: "If Redwood fails to meet remediation milestones for capacity or data egress support and ClearBridge terminates for cause, Redwood will provide a migration credit up to 15% of remaining prepaid platform fees."
- Support: include L2 on-call (business hours PST) during pilot. For conversion, we want pricing for 24/7 on-call as an add-on.

If you can put the SOW + short contract addendum and the DocuSign link over, we'll aim to get procurement sign-off next week.

Thanks — will loop Jane on logistics.

Simon
Procurement Manager | ClearBridge Health

Attachment: signed-NDA-placeholder.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)
